summary: Huginn is an automation tool designed to execute tasks and monitor data sources on your behalf. Built with Ruby under an MIT licence, it allows you to run autonomous agents that interact with web services and trigger automated workflows.
goodFor: It suits technical users who want to self-host their own data pipelines and event-driven automation without relying on commercial third-party platforms.
watchOut: The project shows signs of slowing maintenance activity, which may introduce security risks or compatibility issues over time.
deployNotes: As a Ruby application, deployment typically requires a managed database backend, a process manager for background workers, and a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination securely.
